purpose: Experiment E-CSM-0049 in the cosmology arena: the physical cubic slice grows with polynomial exponent three and zero exponential rate (flat $E^3$, a horosphere) while the bulk tree grows with exponential rate exactly log(branching) and unbounded polynomial exponent (hyperbolic), so our flat space is a horosphere of the curved bulk.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
